parameters.jsCode: const src=$('Build Watchlist').item.json; const d=$json.data||{}; const p=d.primaryData||{}; const clean=v=>{const n=Number(String(v??'').replace(/[$,%+]/g,'')); return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null}; const price=clean(p.lastSalePrice); const changePct=clean(p.percentageChange); return [{json:{documentId:src.ticker,ticker:src.ticker,name:src.name,lastPrice:price,lastChangePercent:changePct,marketFeed:'NASDAQ',monitorStatus:Math.abs(changePct||0)>=5?'MATERIAL_MOVE':'NORMAL',updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.jsCode: const assets=[{ticker:'SPCX',name:'SpaceX'},{ticker:'GOOGL',name:'Alphabet'},{ticker:'AMZN',name:'Amazon'},{ticker:'NVDA',name:'NVIDIA'}]; return assets.map(a=>({json:{...a,prompt:`You are the Factory Investment Office daily analyst. Research ${a.name} (${a.ticker}) using current primary and reputable public sources. Evaluate business quality, valuation, material catalysts, red-team risks, and long-horizon portfolio fit. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys ticker,name,score (0-100),confidence (0-100),status (ACCUMULATE|WATCH|VALUATION CHECK|REDUCE|REVIEW),thesis,materialChange,changeSummary,ownerActionRequired,sourceLinks (array). Do not place or authorize a trade.`}}));

parameters.jsCode: const src=$('Build Daily Prompts').item.json; const r=$json||{}; const text=r.output_text || (r.output||[]).flatMap(o=>o.content||[]).map(c=>c.text||'').join('\n'); let data={}; try{const m=String(text).match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); data=m?JSON.parse(m[0]):{};}catch(e){data={parseError:e.message,raw:text};} return [{json:{documentId:src.ticker,ticker:src.ticker,name:src.name,score:Number(data.score||0),confidence:Number(data.confidence||0),status:data.status||'REVIEW',thesis:data.thesis||'',materialChange:Boolean(data.materialChange),changeSummary:data.changeSummary||'',ownerActionRequired:Boolean(data.ownerActionRequired),sourceLinks:data.sourceLinks||[],updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

return [{json:{prompt:'You are INV-06, the Factory Investment Office long-horizon scout. Search current public markets broadly for investable companies with compelling 5-15 year asymmetric risk-adjusted return potential. Compare candidates against SPCX, GOOGL, AMZN and NVDA. Prefer durable business quality plus underappreciated optionality; reject hype without economics. Return ONLY valid JSON: {candidates:[{ticker,name,score,confidence,thesis,whyNow,bearCase,stage,sourceLinks:[...]}]}. Return at most 8 survivors with score >= 78. Do not place or authorize trades.'}}];

const r=$json||{}; const text=r.output_text || (r.output||[]).flatMap(o=>o.content||[]).map(c=>c.text||'').join('\n'); let data={candidates:[]}; try{const m=String(text).match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m) data=JSON.parse(m[0]);}catch(e){return [{json:{documentId:'RADAR-PARSE-ERROR-'+Date.now(),ticker:'ERROR',name:'Radar parse error',score:0,confidence:0,thesis:String(text).slice(0,1000),stage:'ERROR',discoveredAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];} return (data.candidates||[]).map(c=>({json:{documentId:c.ticker,ticker:c.ticker,name:c.name,score:Number(c.score||0),confidence:Number(c.confidence||0),thesis:c.thesis||'',whyNow:c.whyNow||'',bearCase:c.bearCase||'',stage:c.stage||'SURVIVOR',sourceLinks:c.sourceLinks||[],discoveredAt:new Date().toISOString()}}));

const incoming=$json.body||$json||{}; const asset=incoming.asset||incoming.ticker||'SPCX'; const name=incoming.name|| (asset==='SPCX'?'SpaceX':asset); const roles=[['INV-01','Business Analyst','business quality, moat, management and unit economics'],['INV-02','Valuation Analyst','valuation, scenarios, required return and price discipline'],['INV-03','Bear / Red Team','actively attack the thesis and identify kill criteria'],['INV-04','Market & Catalyst','timing, catalysts, positioning and macro sensitivity'],['INV-05','Portfolio & Risk','position sizing, concentration, correlation and drawdown'],['INV-06','Long-Horizon Scout','5-15 year optionality and alternative opportunities'],['INV-07','Monitor','fresh filings, news, prices and thesis-change signals'],['Q1','Operational QA','calculation consistency, schema and logical correctness'],['Q2','Evidence QA','source quality, freshness, contradictions and unsupported claims'],['Q3','Professional QA','investment-professional completeness and decision quality']]; return roles.map(([id,title,mandate])=>({json:{asset,name,agent:id,prompt:`You are ${id} ${title} in the Factory Investment Office. Independently research ${name} (${asset}) using current primary and reputable public sources. Your mandate is ${mandate}. Do not defer to the other agents. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys agent,asset,score (0-100),confidence (0-100),verdict,analysis,keyEvidence (array),risks (array),sourceLinks (array). No trade execution.`}}));

const src=$('Build Independent Tasks').item.json; const r=$json||{}; const text=r.output_text || (r.output||[]).flatMap(o=>o.content||[]).map(c=>c.text||'').join('\n'); let data={}; try{const m=String(text).match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m) data=JSON.parse(m[0]);}catch(e){data={analysis:text,verdict:'PARSE_REVIEW'};} return [{json:{asset:src.asset,name:src.name,agent:src.agent,...data}}];

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const asset=rows[0]?.asset||'SPCX'; const name=rows[0]?.name||asset; return [{json:{asset,name,prompt:`You are INV-000, Investment Director. Synthesize the independent committee outputs below for ${name} (${asset}). Preserve dissent. Q1/Q2/Q3 are mandatory gates: if a required QA agent identifies a material failure, decision must be REVIEW rather than ACCUMULATE/REDUCE/EXIT. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys ticker,name,decision (ACCUMULATE|WATCH|VALUATION CHECK|REDUCE|EXIT|REVIEW),score (0-100),confidence (0-100),horizon,targetWeight,dca,thesis,bull,bear,kill (array),dissent,qaStatus,ownerActionRequired,sourceLinks (array). Never place or authorize a trade. Committee outputs: ${JSON.stringify(rows)}`}}];

const src=$('Build INV-000 Synthesis').item.json; const r=$json||{}; const text=r.output_text || (r.output||[]).flatMap(o=>o.content||[]).map(c=>c.text||'').join('\n'); let data={}; try{const m=String(text).match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(m) data=JSON.parse(m[0]);}catch(e){data={decision:'REVIEW',score:0,confidence:0,thesis:text,qaStatus:'PARSE_FAILURE'};} const ticker=data.ticker||src.asset; return [{json:{documentId:ticker,id:ticker,ticker,name:data.name||src.name,decision:data.decision||'REVIEW',score:Number(data.score||0),confidence:Number(data.confidence||0),horizon:data.horizon||'10-15 years',targetWeight:data.targetWeight||'REVIEW',dca:data.dca||'Valuation-aware',thesis:data.thesis||'',bull:data.bull||'',bear:data.bear||'',kill:data.kill||[],dissent:data.dissent||'',qaStatus:data.qaStatus||'REVIEW',ownerActionRequired:Boolean(data.ownerActionRequired),sourceLinks:data.sourceLinks||[],marketFeed:'LIVE RESEARCH',updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
